observation.command: echo "=== 18-3.6 ==="; docker run --rm postgis/postgis:18-3.6 sh -c 'grep -E "^VERSION_CODENAME|^ID=" /etc/os-release; cat /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pgdg.list 2>/dev/null' 2>&1 | grep -v "Unable\|Pulling\|Digest\|Status\|Already\|Waiting\|Verifying\|Download\|Pull \|manifest"; echo "=== 17-master ==="; docker run --rm postgis/postgis:17-master sh -c 'grep -E "^VERSION_CODENAME|^ID=" /etc/os-release' 2>&1 | grep -v "Unable\|Pulling\|Digest\|Status\|Already\|Waiting\|Verifying\|Download\|Pull \|manifest"
